summary: Physical UI44 follow-up for #94: independent natural-height responsive card columns even with 24 host readings; CPU and memory utilization derived transparently from monitored idle, total and available metrics; live samples sourced from existing viewer-aware graph feed (one-second UI repaint), delayed gauge samples fall back ONLY to the same producing check's ~15-second metric and are explicitly labeled STATE FALLBACK rather than fabricated LIVE, missing counter rates fail closed. Ethernet line percentage uses an unambiguous public interface speed (including enp51s0 speed mbps) or clearly labels configured graph maximum. Preserves canonical health, v1/v2/v3 snapshots and independent drilldowns. Supersedes signed UI44 dev, signed UI42 beta/stable unchanged; physical UI45 acceptance pending.
